statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The service is consistent with diagnosis codes I49.9 and R55
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to the service date
